data.body_html:
A Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2034 is the ultimate way to capture the Costa del Sol’s golden hour. Departing from Puerto Banús, our fleet of 17 boats—from 6.4m speedboats to a 29m Ferretti—gives you the perfect platform for portraits, couple shots, or content creation. With the sun dipping behind La Concha mountain and the Mediterranean glowing amber, every frame is postcard-ready. Here’s how to plan your session, choose the right boat, and make the most of the light.

Why a Marbella Photoshoot Yacht Sunset Session 2034 Works

The golden hour on the Costa del Sol runs roughly 19:30–21:00 in June, shifting to 18:30–20:00 by October. That 60–90-minute window delivers warm, diffused light that flatters skin tones and makes the sea sparkle. A boat charter from Puerto Banús gives you unobstructed views west toward Estepona or south toward the African coast—no buildings, no crowds. The gentle motion of the yacht adds a natural dynamism to your shots. For a Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2034, we recommend a 2-hour charter starting 60 minutes before sunset.

Best Boats for a Photoshoot Sunset Session in Marbella

Your choice of boat affects the composition and mood of your photos. Here are the top picks from our fleet:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – Clean lines and a spacious aft deck. From €749 for 2 hours (Tier A).
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – Sporty silhouette, ideal for couples. Same Tier A pricing.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – Flybridge offers elevated angles for group shots.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – Open deck with a free jet ski included. From €4,719 for 4 hours (Tier B).
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – Maximum luxury and deck space for editorial-level shoots.

For smaller groups, the Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax) or Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) offer sleek profiles. All depart from Puerto Banús. See the full fleet on our [boat rental Marbella](/) page.

Golden Hour Tips for Your Marbella Photoshoot Yacht Session

To get the best results from your Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2034, follow these practical tips:

  • Timing is everything: Book your charter to start 60 minutes before sunset. The first 30 minutes give direct golden light; the last 30 minutes offer a softer, blue-hour glow.
  • Dress for the light: Light neutrals (cream, beige, blush) or pastels reflect the warm tones. Avoid black or heavy patterns that absorb light.
  • Bring layers: After sunset, the sea breeze can drop the temperature by 5–10°C. A light jacket or shawl is practical and adds texture to photos.
  • Use the boat’s angles: The bow, flybridge (if available), and stern each offer different backdrops—open sea, coastline, or the boat’s own lines.
  • Communicate with the skipper: They can position the boat to face the sun or use the coast as a backdrop. The skipper is also a licensed professional who knows the best anchor spots.

What’s Included in Your Charter

Every Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2034 comes with these inclusions—no hidden costs:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

For Tier B boats (Mangusta 80 white or grey), a jet ski is included free with a 4-hour minimum charter. Pricing for all other boats is available on request via WhatsApp.

Where to Anchor for the Best Sunset Photos

The skipper will choose the best spot based on wind and sea conditions, but these are the most photogenic anchorages near Puerto Banús:

  • West toward Estepona: Open horizon, sun directly ahead. Ideal for silhouettes and wide-angle shots.
  • Cala del Faro: A secluded cove with rocky cliffs that frame the sunset. Great for intimate portraits.
  • Cabopino: Sandy dunes and pine trees in the background. Adds a natural, earthy tone to photos.
  • Off the Golden Mile: The Marbella skyline and La Concha mountain create a dramatic backdrop as the light fades.

Booking Your Marbella Photoshoot Yacht Sunset Session 2034

To secure your preferred date and boat, contact us via WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance for sunset slots between June and September. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours—enough to cover golden hour and the afterglow. For a more relaxed session with outfit changes, consider a 4-hour charter on the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 Flybridge. All charters depart from Puerto Banús. For more inspiration, explore our [experiences](/experiences/) page.
